plugin_voice_input_description: Hold the voice input hotkey and talk: what you say is typed into the game chat (after the blocklist, polishing or translation if you set them up)
plugin_voice_input_off_note: When it's on, hold the voice input hotkey and talk to type into the game chat. Calling her and the wake word keep working while it's off, and she can still speak in the chat for you.
plugin_voice_input_asr_desc: Kotone's speech recognition turns what you say into text; calling her uses the same one. Change the model, download it or start it in Settings.
plugin_voice_input_asr_not_downloaded: The local model isn't downloaded yet
